excluded.x3e83: Modified driving GLB identifies x3e83-owner and source SHA256 6e03b566b6a561ec2079f42e98341c27f7af2f015848535ef8f00809bb0b68f3; CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 source. No modified standalone redistribution grant recorded.
excluded.crv99: Driving GLB identifies crv99-owner/source SHA256 e7d697accb802542a8c3fe09b7f953311e87fb9f5a3ef8df13197a1f28ff4f0d; author/source identified as GMOD Rip in stored source research. No standalone redistribution grant recorded.
excluded.crv99ex: Same restricted crv99-owner source as crv99.
excluded.is300: BlackHorn860 source record grants use in SHITBOX only under Sketchfab Standard; no standalone model redistribution grant recorded.
excluded.accord93: The active runtime identifies the owner-supplied Assetto Corsa conversion (accord93-ac). Stored source terms say no licence file shipped; free availability and game-owner permission do not establish creator/rightsholder permission for standalone redistribution.
excluded.sn95: Current accepted raw GLB contains loose source components beneath the car; the game loader additionally drops exterior panel surfaces. Excluded from this standalone pack pending a separately reviewed source/adapter repair; no game geometry changed.
